failureModes: source capture is incomplete or unauthorized
the desired effect or audience remains materially ambiguous
observations and proposals are presented as the same evidence class
motion or rendering cost has no narrative justification or fallback
acceptance relies on one attractive frame
the selected delegate lacks the required artifact or authority
negativeTriggers: routine copy spacing or component edit
direct final-image generation from an approved prompt
concrete renderer bug or ordinary graphics regression
generic frontend implementation after direction is already settled
certify legal or universal accessibility conformance without named evidence
successCondition: One dominant route produces a source-grounded visual contract whose identity, accessibility, performance, uncertainty, delegation, and rejection criteria are explicit enough for implementation or verification.
terminationConditions: one dominant route owns the current mission
observed extracted inferred and proposed claims remain distinguishable
one coherent visual law governs the system
accessibility performance fallbacks and unknowns are explicit
the next specialist receives a bounded handoff
acceptance can fail against stated rejection criteria
